title: Databricks JDBC Driver (Simba) 2.8.4 is available
body: [Simba JDBC Driver (Legacy)](/aws/en/integrations/jdbc) 2.8.4 adds Java 25 support and upgrades `libthrift`, `httpclient5`, `httpcore5`, and `lz4-java`. Download it from the [JDBC drivers archive](https://www.databricks.com/spark/jdbc-drivers-archive) under **All JDBC Driver Versions (Simba)**.
